# pve_sdn_controller (Resource)

Manages an SDN controller object (`/cluster/sdn/controllers`). Controllers run the routing backbone for EVPN zones (`bgp`, `evpn`, `isis`) or the OpenFlow controller for faucet zones. Changes stay pending until the `pve_sdn_apply` action runs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A controller runs the routing backbone for EVPN zones. Run the
# `pve_sdn_apply` action afterwards to activate pending SDN changes.

resource "pve_sdn_controller" "bgp1" {
  controller = "bgp1"
  type       = "bgp"
  asn        = 65000
  peers      = ["10.0.0.11", "10.0.0.12"]
  loopback   = "lo"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `controller` (String) The SDN controller object identifier (2 to 64 characters, starting with a letter; letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens). Changing this value forces recreation.
- `type` (String) Controller plugin type. Must be one of: `bgp`, `evpn`, `faucet`, `isis`. Changing this value forces recreation.

### Optional

- `asn` (Number) Autonomous system number. BGP and EVPN only. Must be between 0 and 4294967295.
- `bgp_mode` (String) Whether to use eBGP or iBGP; `auto` chooses depending on the BGP controller and falls back to iBGP. BGP only. Must be one of: `auto`, `external`, `internal`.
- `bgp_multipath_as_path_relax` (Boolean) Consider different AS paths of equal length for multipath computation. BGP only.
- `ebgp` (Boolean) Enable eBGP (remote-as external). BGP only.
- `ebgp_multihop` (Number) Maximum amount of hops for eBGP peers; requires `ebgp` to be enabled. BGP only.
- `fabric` (String) SDN fabric used as underlay for this EVPN controller. EVPN only.
- `isis_domain` (String) Name of the IS-IS domain. IS-IS only.
- `isis_ifaces` (List of String) Interfaces where IS-IS should be active. IS-IS only.
- `isis_net` (String) Network Entity title for this node in the IS-IS network, 20 to 50 characters. IS-IS only.
- `loopback` (String) Name of the loopback/dummy interface that provides the Router-IP. BGP only.
- `node` (String) Node where this controller is active.
- `nodes` (List of String) Cluster node names where this controller is active.
- `peer_group_name` (String) Name of the peer group for this EVPN controller; PVE defaults to `VTEP`. EVPN only.
- `peers` (List of String) Peer IP addresses.
- `route_map_in` (String) Route map applied to incoming routes.
- `route_map_out` (String) Route map applied to outgoing routes.

### Read-Only

- `digest` (String) Digest of the controller section.
- `state` (String) State of the SDN configuration object; one of `new`, `changed`, or `deleted` when the configuration has not been applied yet.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing SDN controller by its identifier:
terraform import pve_sdn_controller.bgp1 bgp1
```
